description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Locke
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Mirage Dive (0~2), removed after using Apex Mirage Dive two times

description.name: Apex Mirage Dive Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Mirage Dive level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Fire abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Locke]

description.name: Apex Mirage Dive Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Mirage Dive level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Locke]
